_doc: P90 maximal-consequence impact check (RESEARCH-ONLY, advisory, UN-WIRED). Targets the recurring UNDER-labelling miss (P87 H-01, P89 H-05 rated Medium vs awarded High) + admin-footgun misclassification (P87 H-03) + self-inflicted-vs-involuntary misread (P87 M-18, P85 M-01). It does NOT modify severity_impact_gate; it only RECOMMENDS an impact_class + which gate markers to attach (the same high_liveness_markers / involuntary / liveness tags the P88 gate already consumes). Reject-first: escalation requires source_backed evidence; bounded/lazy with no concrete consequence is NEVER escalated (defers to the gate's bounded-demote). is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false.
escalation_questions: Can this Medium-looking mechanism affect MANY or ALL users (not just the actor)?
Does it brick a CORE protocol function / lifecycle phase / generation?
Is the bad state PERMANENT or unrecoverable without privileged intervention / migration / upgrade?
Can it cause MASS DoS or permanent STATE CORRUPTION?
footgun_vs_user_harm_questions: Is the harmful state reachable ONLY by a privileged admin action with no external trigger?
Is it trivially reversible by the admin with no user funds at risk in the interim?
OR does a normal/plausible admin action produce a USER-FACING consequence (mis-distributed fees, blocked path, lost funds)? -> then it is NOT a mere footgun.
involuntary_vs_self_inflicted_questions: Is the harmed party DIFFERENT from the actor who caused the bad state?
Does it require another user's tx ordering / a race / a third-party listing-or-mint action / global state mutation by someone else / unavoidable sequencing? -> involuntary, NOT self-inflicted.
Is there a concrete asset/reward/right loss? (self-inflicted demotion requires NO material loss AND full avoidability with no race)
_policy: assess(impact_assessment): (1) escalation REQUIRES source_backed=true -> if any high escalator is asserted but source_backed is false, recommend NO escalation ('insufficient'). (2) if source_backed AND >=1 high escalator true -> recommend impact_class 'high' and attach the mapped high_liveness_markers (consumed by the P88 gate). (3) if involuntary (involuntary_third_party_or_race) AND a concrete consequence is present -> recommend KEEP at >= base, attach an involuntary marker, flag 'not self-inflicted'. (4) if admin_initiated AND NOT externally_triggerable_user_harm AND no user funds at risk -> footgun_flag=true, recommend 'do not promote as user harm'. (5) else recommend base unchanged. The check NEVER demotes, NEVER sets production severity, and NEVER escalates a bounded/lazy issue lacking a concrete consequence.
